properties.curationPolicy: Canonical features are rebuilt only from maintained GIS/aerial interpretation and bounded public-provider snapshots. User-supplied KML/KMZ is indicative comparison evidence only and contributes zero parcel, site, bed, or plant features. Provider roofprints use representative-point parcel membership; crossing linear and areal layers must use true intersection plus clipping before any future promotion.
